text:
camila: Deloitte emailed asking for SOC 2 evidence: data retention policy for customer data, audit log exports for last 12 months, and KMS/HSM key rotation proof. They need links + timeline by EOD Fri. @maria can you pull what we have? Thanks :pray:

maria: on it. I have the retention policy page and last year's log export snapshots. Will attach links. Quick Q: they want proof of rotation events for both AWS KMS and our on-prem HSM, right?

auditor_jones: hi team—yes please, rotation events for master keys and any wrap/unwrap logs. Also want the control mappings for CC6/CC7. A consolidated list is fine.

jordan: FYI the HSM team rotated the master wrap key 2025-06-12 (ticket INF-4231). I can export HSM audit trail. Give me the exact format the auditor prefers (CSV, ndjson?).

maria: auditor said CSV is easiest. I'll generate:

```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit-exports/soc2/2025/* ./
python tools/filter_kms_rotation.py --input ./ --output rotation_events_2025.csv
```

maria: uploading rotation_events_2025.csv and audit_log_export_2025-01-01_to_2025-12-31.ndjson.gz to the Confluence evidence space now: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/SOC2/Evidence

ops-bot: upload complete: /confluence/SOC2/Evidence/rotation_events_2025.csv (sha256: 9f2b6c8a...)

auditor_jones: Received. Can you also include the key IDs and the IAM change log showing who approved the rotation? Need approver and timestamp.

maria: yes — adding IAM approval screenshots and the Jira ticket links: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/INF-4231

camila: timeline summary (for auditor):
- policy last updated: 2024-11-08 (confluence)
- KMS rotation schedule: annual; last rotation: 2025-06-12
- HSM wrap key rotation: 2025-06-12 (ticket INF-4231)
- audit log retention window: 3 yrs (see policy)

auditor_jones: thanks. One more: can you provide evidence of secure key deletion for retired keys? We need the zeroization proof or deletion logs.

jordan: ok — HSM zeroize logs are here: /hsm/logs/zeroize_2025-06-12.log. I'll redact device serials and upload.

maria: done, uploaded zeroize_2025-06-12.log (redacted) to Confluence. Also exported S3 object versioning logs for the schema: s3://redwood-audit-exports/soc2/versions/

auditor_jones: perfect. last ask: a one-page control narrative mapping evidence files to SOC 2 criteria. could someone draft?

camila: i can draft a quick mapping and post it as a PDF. timeline: will upload by 17:00 PST today.

sara: i'll review the mapping and sign off.

maria: uploaded control_mapping_SOC2_v1.pdf at 16:42 PST. link: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/SOC2/Evidence#control_mapping_SOC2_v1.pdf

auditor_jones: got it — reviewing now. thanks all, will follow up if any clarifications.

camila: great job team :tada:
